## Scope

- [ ] This change helps **template users in general**, not only my own workspace.
- [ ] I did **not** include real personal data, private media, tokens or
      credentials (this repo is public; `content/` is a fictional example).

## Checks

- [ ] `content/*.yaml` parses (the `yaml` CI job).
- [ ] If `content/` or `.pascorc` changed: `pasco validate` and `pasco check`
      pass against the pinned engine, and `profiles/` was regenerated by
      `pasco build` — **not** edited by hand.
- [ ] Relative markdown links resolve (`bash .github/scripts/check-links.sh`).
- [ ] `bash .github/scripts/check-example-data.sh` passes.
- [ ] If a workflow changed: every action is pinned by full commit SHA, and the
      job's `permissions:` is the minimum it needs.
- [ ] Docs updated in the same PR: **both** members of each language pair —
      `README.md`/`README.es.md`, `CHECKLIST.md`/`CHECKLIST.es.md` — when the
      paired content changes, plus `CHANGELOG.md` for user-visible changes.
